metadata.description: Name of the existing virtual machine.
Auto-generated salt to make names unique per deployment.
Resource group of the existing virtual machine.

properties.scriptContent:
param([string]$rgName,[string]$vmName)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
# Ensure subscription context for UAMI in DeploymentScript container
$_ctx = Get-AzContext; if (-not $_ctx.Subscription.Id) { $_sub = (Get-AzSubscription -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).Id; Set-AzContext -SubscriptionId $_sub -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Output ("[INFO] Set subscription context to $_sub") }
Write-Output '[STEP 0] Stopping VM...'
Stop-AzVM -ResourceGroupName $rgName -Name $vmName -Force
Write-Output '[INFO] Waiting for VM to reach StoppedDeallocated state...'
do {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 30
    $vmStatus = (Get-AzVM -ResourceGroupName $rgName -Name $vmName -Status).Statuses.DisplayStatus
    Write-Output "[STATUS] VM: $vmStatus"
} while ($vmStatus -notcontains 'VM deallocated')
Write-Output '[DONE] VM is stopped and deallocated.'

properties.arguments: [format(' -rgName "{0}" -vmName "{1}" -timeStamp "{2}" -extensionsJsonB64 "{3}" -bootEnabled "{4}" -bootStorageUri "{5}" -securityType "{6}"', parameters('resourceGroupName'), parameters('vmName'), parameters('timeparameter'), if(equals(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.extensionsJsonB64, ''), '_NULL_', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.extensionsJsonB64), if(equals(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.bootEnabled, ''), 'False', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.bootEnabled), if(equals(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.bootStorageUri, ''), '_NULL_', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.bootStorageUri), if(or(equals(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.securityType, ''), equals(reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.securityType, '_NULL_')), '_NULL_', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Resources/deploymentScripts', format('CaptureSourceVM-{0}', parameters('vmName'))), '2020-10-01').outputs.securityType))]
